Title: 503635-2026: France – Building construction work – Design-and-build contract with negotiated procedure for the refurbishment of the Résidence CHAMP DE MARS comprising 592 collective housing units in PERPIGNAN (66).
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Medium relevance: The large refurbishment project with 592 apartments is a significant building construction project and therefore potentially of interest. However, it is residential construction in France (no bridge or particularly demanding structure and not in DACH/Germany), hence lower priority.
titel: Design-and-build contract with negotiated procedure for the refurbishment of the CHAMP DE MARS residential complex with 592 multi-storey apartments in Perpignan (66)
kurzbeschreibung: In Perpignan, a combined design-and-build contract has been awarded for the comprehensive refurbishment of the "Résidence CHAMP DE MARS" residential complex with 592 apartments. The contract covers architectural and engineering services as well as construction works over approximately 36 months.
gewinner_rolle: General contractor / design-and-build provider (planning and construction execution)
gewinner_kontakt: Contract value: 28460000 EUR; Registered office: 57950 Montigny-lès-Metz, France; Registration number: 790 843 411 00022
projektbeteiligte:
HABITAT PERPIGNAN MEDITERRANEE – public contracting authority and paying agency
DEMATHIEU BARD CONSTRUCTION – winner, general contractor (conception-réalisation)
Tribunal Judiciaire de MARSEILLE – review body
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Refurbishment of a large residential complex, but without special structural or special construction characteristics
- Design-and-build contract, structural design is likely integrated in the GC team and already awarded
- Location France, not a strategic target market with high priority such as Africa or DACH
- No indication of long-span structures, bridges, or complex cultural buildings
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in France, checking engineer services there are less established for us
- Conception-réalisation with GC: in-house planning, low likelihood of an external checking engineer mandate
- Pure residential use without evidently complex structural requirements
baukosten_erklaerung: Read from the notice: published contract value for building construction works
naechste_schritte: No active acquisition recommended. Only passive monitoring of the project; no need to contact the winner.
notes: Phase: Appel à candidatures is mentioned in the text, but the contract was already awarded on 16/07/2026. Structural design is part of the design-and-build package and is therefore very likely already included in the scope of DEMATHIEU BARD CONSTRUCTION and/or their planning partners.
